title: Interlanguage and Mathematical Translation Methodology Sidecar
version: 2026-07-18 v0.11 Noether R823 completion gate and Romance v10
description:
This is the methodology and reproducibility sidecar for the AI-run mathematical translation program. It preserves interlanguage source baselines, weighted-automaton and terminology work, manager handoffs, Interslavic normalization evidence, Romance-language infrastructure, reusable scripts, and bounded translation experiments.

Open first: 00_Interlanguage_Methodology_Current_v11_20260718.pdf. It maps the current record and explains the new Noether R823 completion gate without presenting infrastructure as a finished language edition.

New in v0.11: 15_Noether_R823_Translation_Completion_Gate_v4_20260718.zip contains the exact 35-check gate, adversarial replay, readable final audit, structured all-page visual-review record, terminology locator audit, and a complete 473-page candidate-derived render baseline under a pinned 120-dpi Poppler profile. The Spanish replay passes all 35 declared checks against the verified R823 authority and exact current 473-page candidate. All 81 declared units are source-reconciled in the evidence graph; 68 independently hash-pinned native Spanish TeX line witnesses meet the terminology-source minimum, while 33 target-only decisions remain visible but excluded.

Romance v10: the record continues to carry the current Romance routing, source, WordWeb, semantic-alignment, access, bounded-production, and QA infrastructure. It records 61 language or variety routes, 60 concepts, 106 senses, 682 reviewed occurrence records, and six bounded controlled-Romance tranches. It contains zero human intelligibility observations and does not claim a completed Romance translation or empirical intelligibility result.

Classification: the passing Spanish gate certifies the declared scope, artifact, evidence, build, and render bindings. It is not native-language certification, peer review, proof of semantic perfection, mathematical proof checking, or critical-edition certification. The French R823 lane remains active and moving. The actual Spanish reader and editable translation package are published on 10.5281/zenodo.21422620 under the Noether concept DOI.

GitHub: corrections and improved evidence can be proposed through issues or pull requests at https://github.com/KokunoYumeto/modern-latex-manuscripts.
notes: v0.11 adds the Noether R823 completion gate v4 and its passing Spanish evidence, including candidate-derived pixel binding. It does not certify native-language quality, semantic perfection, mathematical correctness, peer review, or critical-edition status.
